adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, both `update` and `destroy` fetch records via `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first`. If the id is unknown, `host` will be `nil`, and `save_host(host)` will call `host.host = ...` (NoMethodError) and `destroy` will call `host.destroy` (NoMethodError), producing a 500 instead of a proper not-found response. This is directly verifiable from the diff. The `.all.order(:host)` in `Admin::EmbeddingController` is indeed redundant but is just a style/minor issue, not the core defect.
